quiz.title: JLPT N4 KANJI CHECK
quiz.questionEn: Which English meaning matches the Kanji 「駅」?

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: みなさん、こんばんは！今日はJLPT N4でよく使う五つの漢字を楽しく学びましょう。
lines.romaji: Minasan, konbanwa! Kyou wa JLPT N4 de yoku tsukau itsutsu no kanji o tanoshiku manabimashou.
lines.english: Good evening everyone! Today let's cheerfully learn five super-useful JLPT N4 Kanji.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.japanese: わあ、楽しみです！よろしくお願いします、先生！
lines.romaji: Waa, tanoshimi desu! Yoroshiku onegaishimasu, Sensei!
lines.english: Ooh, I'm excited! Please teach us well, Sensei!

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: まず一つ目の漢字、こちらのボードを見てください！「朝」、Morningです。
lines.romaji: Mazu hitotsume no kanji, kochira no boodo o mite kudasai! "Asa", Morning desu.
lines.english: First Kanji — please look at the board here! "Asa" means Morning.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.japanese: 毎朝の「朝」ですね！朝日と月のイラストで覚えやすいです！
lines.romaji: Maiasa no "asa" desu ne! Asahi to tsuki no irasuto de oboeyasui desu!
lines.english: That's the "asa" in every morning! The sunrise and moon picture makes it easy to remember!

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: いいですね！その調子で次に行きましょう。
lines.romaji: Ii desu ne! Sono choushi de tsugi ni ikimashou.
lines.english: Great job! Let's keep that momentum going to the next one.

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 二つ目はこちらのボードを見てください！「駅」、Train Stationです。東京駅などで毎日見ますよ。
lines.romaji: Futatsume wa kochira no boodo o mite kudasai! "Eki", Train Station desu. Toukyou-eki nado de mainichi mimasu yo.
lines.english: Look here on the board for number two! "Eki" means Train Station — seen daily at Tokyo Station.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.japanese: 駅前の「駅」もこれですね！よくわかります。
lines.romaji: Ekimae no "eki" mo kore desu ne! Yoku wakarimasu.
lines.english: So the "eki" in front of the station uses this too! Got it.

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 三つ目を見てください！「勉」、Effortの意味です。日本語の勉強も、毎日のコツコツした力ですね。
lines.romaji: Mittsume o mite kudasai! "Ben", Effort no imi desu. Nihongo no benkyou mo, mainichi no kotsukotsu shita chikara desu ne.
lines.english: Look at number three! "Ben" means Effort — steady daily power for Japanese study.

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 四つ目はこちら！「料」、IngredientsやFeeという意味です。日本料理や無料でも使います。
lines.romaji: Yottsume wa kochira! "Ryou", Ingredients ya Fee to iu imi desu. Nihon-ryouri ya muryou de mo tsukaimasu.
lines.english: Fourth on the board! "Ryou" means Ingredients or Fee, used in Japanese cooking and free-of-charge.

lines.speaker: Maria
lines.japanese: 日本料理と無料、どっちも旅行ですぐ使えますね！
lines.romaji: Nihon-ryouri to muryou, docchi mo ryokou de sugu tsukaemasu ne!
lines.english: Japanese cooking and free of charge — both are super useful for travel!

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 素晴らしい！まさにその通りです。
lines.romaji: Subarashii! Masa ni sono toori desu.

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 最後は五つ目、ボードを見てください！「話」、SpeakやStoryです。会話や電話の言葉に欠かせません。
lines.romaji: Saigo wa itsutsume, boodo o mite kudasai! "Hanasu", Speak ya Story desu. Kaiwa ya denwa no kotoba ni kakasemasen.
lines.english: Fifth and final Kanji on the board! "Hanasu" means Speak or Story, essential for conversation and phone.

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: さあ、クイズです！ボードにある「駅」の意味はどれでしょう？考えてみてくださいね。
lines.romaji: Saa, kuizu desu! Boodo ni aru "eki" no imi wa dore deshou? Kangaete mite kudasai ne.
lines.english: Quiz time! What does the Kanji "eki" on the board mean? Take a moment to think!

lines.speaker: Sensei
lines.japanese: 正解はBのTrain Station、駅でした！よくできましたね！また次のエピソードで会いましょう。
lines.romaji: Seikai wa B no Train Station, eki deshita! Yoku dekimashita ne! Mata tsugi no episoodo de aimashou.
lines.english: The correct answer is B, Train Station! Well done! See you in the next episode.
